requirements.text: Required Skills - Programming experience. Your job will require you to code. We mainly write in Python, so experience in this language is preferred. Familiarity with another lower-level language (C/C++, Go, etc) is a plus Software engineering experience. You enjoy software engineering and know your way around algorithm design and data structures. You are comfortable working in Linux-based systems and are familiar with using Docker to develop and deliver RESTful APIs. Additional experience in areas such as cloud computing, distributed systems, CI/CD, etc., is a plus. Capacity for autonomy. You won’t be on your own on day one, but you will need the capacity to manage your time between research and tool development. Strong communication skills. You are comfortable adjusting how you discuss software engineering projects, from the technical details to high-level concepts, depending on your audience of software engineer teammates, data scientist collaborators, and non-technical business stakeholders.

Adaptable. Toolkit problems will involve different areas of computer science and machine learning skills, sometimes within the same problem. You can context shift depending on the problem and can adjust if new problems and/or requirements arise requiring rethinking the approach to solving a problem.

Detail oriented. Toolkit is focused on making tools that just work. You like to find edge cases and potential bugs in code, you go above and beyond developing use cases beyond the requested basics, and you are meticulous with following software engineering best practices, including writing maintainable code with clear documentation and comprehensive test cases.

Skills to Stand Out. You like to code and have interest in learning new technologies. You find it exciting to explore and/or improve libraries to help you solve a problem. Lifelong engineering. You want to stay up to date with regards to practicing engineering and you strive for continuous learning and improvement.

Curiosity about machine learning. You know a few things about learning algorithms, data preprocessing strategies, or some other interesting areas of machine learning that can help create more integrated and robust software solutions.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.
